AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Bookworm
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has always been interested in acquiring new knowledge. Ever since childhood, {PAWN_pronoun} read every book that fell into {PAWN_possessive} hands.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Fighter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: As a child, {PAWN_nameDef} was always ready to stand up for others and never shied away from a good fight, fighting to the very end.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Leader
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} was always a leader. Whether at school or among friends, {PAWN_pronoun} always made the decisions, and people followed {PAWN_objective}.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Artist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Having spent many years drawing, {PAWN_nameDef} developed a talent for creativity and for making works of art.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Space kid
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} was born and raised on a spaceship. For a long time, {PAWN_pronoun} wandered with the crew from planet to planet, never finding a home on any of them. Since there were no children {PAWN_possessive} age on the ship, {PAWN_pronoun} got used to acting like an adult from childhood.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Commando soldier
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: After many years of hard training, {PAWN_nameDef} joined the asari space fleet and became a special forces soldier.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Fleet scientist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: High-tech equipment is the key to victory in any war, so {PAWN_nameDef} dedicated years of {PAWN_possessive} life to science and to advancing the technology of the asari space fleet.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Fleet tactician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} joined a combat unit of the asari space fleet. Giving orders to {PAWN_possessive} squad in battle, {PAWN_pronoun} showed composure and a sharp mind. Later, {PAWN_pronoun} became a brilliant commander, coolly directing entire armadas of ships in battle.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Educated bodyguard
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Hoping to change {PAWN_possessive} life, {PAWN_nameDef} left the science department and enlisted in the asari army, where {PAWN_pronoun} learned and honed {PAWN_possessive} combat skills. Later, {PAWN_pronoun} served in the personal guard of the asari space fleet's officers.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Bodyguard
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} found work in the asari space fleet, diligently protecting those who paid {PAWN_objective} well. {PAWN_pronoun} lived long enough to gain experience in all kinds of fights, and became known for {PAWN_possessive} ruthlessness toward those who crossed {PAWN_objective}.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Field medic
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} used to work as a doctor at a city hospital.
